name: Natra Bintan, a Tribute Portfolio Resort
short_description: Tribute Portfolio glamping resort in Bintan's Lagoi area, with safari-style tents beside Southeast Asia's first man-made Crystal Lagoon, a short ferry ride from Singapore.
ai_summary: Natra Bintan, a Tribute Portfolio Resort (formerly The Canopi) is a family-friendly glamping resort in the Lagoi/Bintan Resorts zone, set beside the Crystal Lagoon at Treasure Bay, roughly an hour by ferry from Singapore. Accommodation is around 100 safari-inspired tents ranging from Garden to Lagoon View and Deluxe categories, most pairing an air-conditioned bedroom with a semi-outdoor rainforest-style bathroom, private patio, king bed, LED TV and mini-fridge; larger tents add jetted tubs. Independent reviewers consistently praise the spacious, distinctive tents, the calm turquoise lagoon and its wide range of activities (kayaking, water slides, cable-ski, ATV, archery and mangrove tours), plus warm, personable staff. It reads as a novel, kid-friendly escape rather than a polished beach resort. Watch-outs recur: dining is concentrated at a single all-day venue, The Patio, and both restaurant meals and in-tent BBQs are widely called overpriced with limited choice. The open-concept bathrooms trade privacy and can let in insects, some tents show their age, and occasional aircraft noise is noted. Nearby attractions are limited, so most excursions require arranged transport. TripAdvisor scores it about 4.1 of 5 across roughly 979 reviews, ranking mid-pack among Lagoi hotels, reflecting a strong glamping concept let down mainly by food value.

Warm, attentive, personable staff frequently highlighted in reviews
Easy to reach from Singapore by a roughly one-hour ferry, no flight needed

research_highlights: Formerly The Canopi; billed as the first glamping resort on Bintan Island, set beside the 6.3-hectare Crystal Lagoon at Treasure Bay
Around 100 safari-inspired tents across Garden, Lagoon View and Deluxe categories
TripAdvisor rating about 4.1/5 from roughly 979 reviews, ranked #9 of 16 hotels in Lagoi

faqs.question: How do I get to Natra Bintan from Singapore?
faqs.answer: Take a ferry from Singapore's Tanah Merah terminal to Bandar Bentan Telani in Lagoi, roughly a one-hour crossing, then a short resort transfer. The nearest airport is Raja Haji Fisabilillah (TNJ) in Tanjung Pinang, about 65 km south by road.

faqs.question: What kind of accommodation does the resort offer?
faqs.answer: It is a glamping resort with around 100 safari-inspired tents in Garden, Lagoon View and Deluxe categories. Each has an air-conditioned bedroom, private patio, king bed, LED TV and mini-fridge, most with a semi-outdoor rainforest-style bathroom; larger tents add jetted tubs.

faqs.question: Is Natra Bintan good for families?
faqs.answer: Yes. Reviewers repeatedly call it family-friendly thanks to the calm Crystal Lagoon and activities like water slides, kayaking, cable-ski, ATV rides and archery. The spacious tents suit families, though open-concept bathrooms and higher dining prices are worth noting when planning.
